BLOCKSMITH&Co. 1st Anniversary! A Report on Our Social Gathering!
Hello. This is Leia from BLOCKSMITH&Co. PR&HR.
On April 1, 2023, BLOCKSMITH&Co., Inc. celebrated its first anniversary. We held a social gathering to commemorate the occasion, and I'd like to report on how it went!
About 30 BLS employees gathered at our CEO Sanada's villa, including interns, prospective employees who have yet to join, and even the young daughter of one of our directors.
Members of the Planning, Marketing, and Administration departments, who finished their meetings early, went out to buy food and drinks, and the event finally kicked off at 7:00 PM.

Inside, there was plenty of food, including several large pizzas, Korean cuisine, and sushi! We also had a BBQ on the balcony. Some members even brought their own special seasonings, leading to lively discussions about their various preferences! The children had orange juice, while the adults mixed their favorite drinks. Although everyone is usually busy working at a fast pace, tonight was a great

With the sudden increase in staff since the end of the year, there are some members who don't interact much in their daily work, but I think many were able to enjoy some deep communication by having a relaxed conversation at this gathering.
